item.title: Bulletin updated at 17:10 HKT 31/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Mawar will move across seas east of Taiwan in the next couple of days, and then move towards seas south of Japan and weaken gradually. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, it will be persistently very hot over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. A moderate easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong early next week. There will still be a few showers over the region. A broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the northern part of the South China Sea early to midweek next week.
